description: This file contains utility functions for managing Redux state, including object and array manipulations, state persistence setup, and deep equality checks. It is specific to the Superset project, providing project-specific state management helpers.

methods.name: addToObject
methods.description: Adds a new object to a specified key in the state, generating a unique id if necessary.

methods.name: alterInObject
methods.description: Modifies an object within a state key by applying alterations.

methods.name: alterInArr
methods.description: Replaces an item in an array within the state with an altered version based on matching id.

methods.name: removeFromArr
methods.description: Removes an object from an array in the state based on matching id.

methods.name: getFromArr
methods.description: Retrieves an object from an array by id.

methods.name: addToArr
methods.description: Adds a new object to an array in the state, with optional prepending.

methods.name: extendArr
methods.description: Appends or prepends multiple objects to an array in the state, assigning ids if missing.

methods.name: initEnhancer
methods.description: Initializes Redux store enhancer with optional persistence and debugging options.

methods.name: areArraysShallowEqual
methods.description: Checks if two arrays are shallowly equal.

methods.name: areObjectsEqual
methods.description: Performs deep equality check between two objects with options to ignore certain fields or null/undefined values.
